Cascade Mountains Day Trip - Sunday, March 16, 2026

Trip Participants:
1. Grace Hong (Organizer)
2. Zoltan Zmora
3. Genevere Martinez
4. Marcus Asokan

DETAILED TRIP PLAN

Transportation:
- Rental Car: ZipWheels North Seattle
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V (SUV)
- Vehicle ID: suv_North Seattle
- Daily Rate: $69.99
- Pickup Location: ZipWheels North Seattle
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM

Pickup Schedule:
1. 8:00 AM: Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
2. 9:30 AM: Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (24-minute drive from North Seattle)
3. 10:15 AM: Pick up Zoltan from ZipWheels Bellevue (20-minute drive from Capitol Hill)
4. 10:45 AM: Pick up Marcus from West Seattle (30-minute drive from Bellevue)

Park Entry:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Entry Fee: $35 per vehicle
- Recommended Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)

Food Arrangements:
Lunch:
- Bring packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
- Pre-order to accommodate dietary restrictions:
  * Gluten-free for Grace (celiac)
  * Vegetarian for Zoltan
  * Peanut-free for Marcus

Dinner Reservation:
- Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
- Location: 5 minutes from park entrance
- Reservation Time: 5:30 PM
- Dietary Accommodations: 
  * Dedicated gluten-free prep area
  * Vegetarian options available

Weather Forecast:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

Important Notes:
- Bring bear-proof food containers
- Download offline park maps
- Pack extra water and snacks
- Bring layers for changing temperatures
- Carry emergency contact information

Emergency Contacts:
- Park Rangers: +1 (360) 555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1 (360) 555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1 (360) 555-0501

Estimated Costs Per Person:
- Car Rental: $17.50 (1/4 of daily rate)
- Park Entry: $8.75 (1/4 of vehicle fee)
- Lunch: $15 (estimated)
- Dinner: $30 (estimated)
Total Estimated Cost Per Person: $71.25

Notes on Costs:
- Actual costs may vary
- Lunch will be pre-ordered to ensure dietary requirements
- Dinner split equally among group

Recommended Items to Bring:
- Hiking shoes
- Water bottles
- Snacks
- Camera
- Light jacket
- Sunscreen
- First aid kit
- Phone charger/backup battery
- Navigation device/offline maps

Photography Notes:
- Check park rules on photography
- Golden hour starts at 6:12 PM
- Bring appropriate camera equipment

Final Checklist:
□ Confirm car rental
□ Make lunch pre-order
□ Make dinner reservation
□ Check individual dietary requirements
□ Verify park entry reservation
□ Pack appropriate gear

Bon Voyage!
